# coloclize

The goal of coloclize is to provide reproducible code for the
colocalization analysis of the paper …

## Installation

You can install the development version of coloclize like so:

``` r
remotes::install.packages("sounkou-bioinfo/colocalize")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`magma_exec()`](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/colocalize/reference/magma_exec.md)
  : magma executable path
- [`make_flames_venv()`](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/colocalize/reference/make_flames_venv.md)
  : make FLAMES python package venv
- [`make_pops_venv()`](https://sounkou-bioinfo.github.io/colocalize/reference/make_pops_venv.md)
  : make pops python package venv
